s.note: the busy morning market in Belle's village
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with olive oil and toast until golden. Top half with brie and thin slices of red apple. Top the rest with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey. Lay them out on a wooden board like a village market stall.

s.note: Gaston showing off at the village tavern
s.how: Boil 12 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon and snipped chives until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and dust with smoked paprika. Pile onto one big platter, because no one eats eggs like Gaston.

m.note: the grand dinner show in the castle dining room
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck and 150g bacon. Add 250g mushrooms and 200g peeled pickling onions and cook until golden. Pour in a bottle of red wine and simmer for 3 hours until rich. Serve over buttery mash from 1kg potatoes.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Fill with 500ml thick custard. Slice 3 red apples paper thin, soften briefly in lemony water, then arrange in overlapping circles into a rose. Bake at 180C for 20 minutes and glaze with warm apricot jam.

d.how: Pour peach nectar into tall glasses to halfway and top with sparkling apple juice. Add a slice of orange to each. For the grown-ups, top the peach with sparkling wine instead. Serve before the ballroom dance.
